items.title: Why Does Adaptive Batching Help LLM Pretraining? A Perspective from Unbounded Variance
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.02355v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Increasing the batch size during training is a common practice in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet the theoretical justification behind its success is not well understood. Analyses of stochastic optimization often assume uniformly bounded stochastic gradient variance, yet recent evidence suggests that this assumption fails in many practical nonconvex problems. The Blum--Gladyshev (BG-$0$) noise model relaxes this assumption by allowing the variance to grow quadratically with the distance from initialization, suggesting that batch size schedulers can help by controlling the variance growth during training. However, this growth can be overly conservative in practice. We empirically investigate variance growth in LLM pretraining and observe that a generalized BG model with a tunable growth exponent provides a tighter description of practical noise behavior. items.summary_zh: 该论文探讨LLM预训练中增大批大小这一常见做法背后的理论依据。传统随机优化分析假设随机梯度方差有界，但近期证据表明该假设在实际中不成立。作者从无界方差视角出发，分析自适应批大小策略的有效性，揭示其如何缓解方差影响、加速收敛。研究为理解大批量训练的成功提供了新的理论框架，对优化器设计和预训练实践具有指导意义。

items.title: Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.02798v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. items.summary_zh: 该论文探究 Muon 优化器为何在大规模神经网络训练中表现优异。Muon 对矩阵形式的更新施加谱正交化，但其在特征学习中的机制此前理解不足。作者构建了一个可解析的事实回忆模型，其中每条事实将某个输入映射到对应输出，用以分析谱正交化对学习动态的影响。研究发现，谱正交化能够改善奇异值分布、平衡不同方向的学习速度，从而使模型更有效地记忆事实。该工作为理解 Muon 的优化机理提供了理论视角。

items.title: Planning to Learn
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.03667v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Policy-gradient methods are central to modern reinforcement learning, including LLM post-training. When they struggle, the usual suspects are exploration, credit assignment and action-sampling noise. Classification has none of them. A classifier is a policy whose expected reward, its \emph{expected accuracy}, is the probability it assigns to the correct label, and because that label is known, the policy gradient is exact and smooth. Yet exact policy gradient loses to cross-entropy, even on expected accuracy. The exact gradient is myopic: it values an update only by what it buys now, but each update also sets where the next one starts, so an update's value depends on how much learning remains. Viewed this way, cross-entropy is patient accuracy, the total error an example would pay if its log-odds rose at unit speed forever, while exact policy gradient is the zero-horizon limit. items.reason_zh: 以分类器为无探索、无信用分配的纯策略，重新审视策略梯度困境，视角反直觉且有启发。
items.summary_zh: 该论文从分类任务切入重新审视策略梯度方法。策略梯度是现代强化学习及 LLM 后训练的核心，其常见困难被归结为探索、信用分配和动作采样噪声。作者指出，分类器本质上就是一个策略：其期望奖励即期望准确率，等于它赋予正确类别的概率。而分类任务恰恰不存在上述三个问题——没有探索、没有信用分配、也没有采样噪声。通过这一对照，论文剖析策略梯度在何种意义上真正困难，并探讨从分类视角理解与改进策略优化的可能路径。

items.title: Training-Loss Guarantees for Muon with Finite-Step Newton--Schulz Orthogonalization
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2610.03306v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Existing convergence analyses of Muon either assume exact orthogonalization or analyze classical Newton--Schulz polynomials, and guarantee only stationarity, so it is unresolved what Muon's five tuned Newton--Schulz steps preserve and whether that suffices to reach a prescribed neural-network training loss. We establish a finite-time training guarantee that accounts for both momentum accumulation before orthogonalization and the tuned finite-step update. For full-batch training of a sufficiently wide two-layer ReLU network with fixed random output weights and a positive-definite limiting neural tangent kernel, we prove that Muon reaches any target empirical squared loss $\varepsilon>0$ with high probability over initialization. items.reason_zh: 为 Muon 有限步 Newton-Schulz 正交化给出训练损失保证，回答五步近似是否足够的关键问题。
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究 Muon 优化器在有限步 Newton-Schulz 正交化下的收敛性质。此前对 Muon 的收敛分析要么假设精确正交化，要么只分析经典 Newton-Schulz 多项式，且仅能保证收敛到稳定点，因此 Muon 实际使用的五步调优 Newton-Schulz 究竟保留了什么性质、是否足以达到预设的训练损失，一直未有定论。作者建立了有限时间训练损失保证，证明在有限步近似下 Muon 仍能达到给定的训练损失水平，为其实用配置提供了理论支撑。
items.title_zh: 有限步 Newton-Schulz 正交化下 Muon 的训练损失保证

items.title: AI写的测试到底有多水？
items.raw_text:
本文记录了一次完整的单人变异测试实战：在一个万行代码的 Python 后端项目上，三天内从零搭建 CI + 变异测试两条管线，跑完 10197 个变异体测出 47% 基线杀死率，通过四分类分诊 + 多 Agent 协作 + 核验循环，将杀死率提升至 77.6%，补了 248 个测试零回归。文章同时讨论了代价：功能停滞、紧箍咒效应、灵活性下降，以及对设计书完善度的依赖。

items.title: What we learned building a browser agent on a classifier instead of an LLM
items.raw_text:
Hi all,

We built IronBee Express, a browser agent where every step is one call to a classifier, TypeSafe's Jev. Jev picks an action and a control from what's offered and never writes text. An LLM only steps in to write free text, to get a stuck run moving, or to explain a failure.

We wrote up what worked and what broke. The parts I think are useful beyond our project:

- Guidance belongs in the options, not the prompt. Five extra rules in the instructions made Google Flights runs slower (median 8.11 s to 9.66 s). One sentence added to the WAIT option cut a run of 8 waits in a row to 3 at most.

- One request per step, asking for every operation's target at once, keeps a step at about 300 ms. Its side effect: the questions can't see each other, which is how a card number once landed in a PIN field.

items.summary_zh: 作者分享了构建 IronBee Express 浏览器 agent 的经验：每一步只调用一次分类器 TypeSafe 的 Jev，由 Jev 从给定选项中挑选动作和控制指令，从不生成文本。LLM 仅在需要写自由文本、推动卡住的运行或解释失败原因时介入。文章详细记录了这种架构哪些部分有效、哪些部分出了问题，属于对真实系统设计取舍的工程复盘，对 agent 开发者理解分类器与 LLM 分工有参考价值。

items.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
items.raw_text: Trust gaps in the new protocol spread malicious prompts from one agent to another.
items.reason_zh: Ars Technica 揭示 MCP 用于智能体间通信时的信任缺口与提示注入风险，对 agent 开发者有警示价值。
items.summary_zh: Ars Technica 报道指出，将 MCP（Model Context Protocol）用于智能体间（agent-to-agent）通信可能是最危险却鲜为人知的协议之一。文章核心观点是：该新协议存在信任缺口，恶意提示（malicious prompt）可借助这一缺口从一个智能体传播到另一个智能体，形成链式污染。报道提示开发者在多智能体系统中采用 MCP 时需警惕跨代理的提示注入与信任边界问题，属于对新兴协议安全风险的技术性分析。
items.title_zh: 用于智能体间通信的 MCP 可能是你从未听说过的最危险协议

items.title: Attempts to Keep Humans in the AI Loop May Actually Push Them Out
items.raw_text:
A crucial safeguard against AI agents going rogue—keeping humans in the loop to review and approve their decisions—will fail unless designers and users change their current practices, a trio of leading AI ethics researchers argue.

Though most autonomous agents have systems to keep users in the loop about their actions, in practice these processes actually push humans out of the loop, the authors argue in a paper posted to ArXiv on 6 September. items.reason_zh: IEEE Spectrum 分析人类在环安全机制可能反而将人排除在外，对 AI 安全设计有反直觉洞察。
items.summary_zh: IEEE Spectrum 发表文章，探讨 AI 智能体安全中“人类在环”（human-in-the-loop）机制的实际效果。文章指出，尽管让人类审查 AI 行为被视为防止智能体失控的关键保障，但实际设计中，由于审查任务繁重、界面不友好或决策时间紧迫，人类可能被逐渐边缘化，甚至被系统“推出”循环。作者通过案例和分析揭示这一悖论，呼吁重新思考人机协作的安全设计，确保人类监督真正有效而非形式化。
